data.cleaned_text: Mahigit 1,000 jeepney drivers sa Southern Metro Manila ang nagsagawa ng transport strike simula kahapon at nanawagan ng rollback sa presyo ng petrolyo, suspensyon ng VAT at excise tax, at pagpawi sa Oil Deregulation Law. Ayon sa PISTON ay posibleng palawigin ang kilos-protesta kung hindi matutugunan ng gobyerno ang kanilang hinaing.
data.english_translation: More than 1,000 jeepney drivers in the Southern Metro Manila have conducted transport strike since yesterday and have called rollback at petroleum prices, VAT and excise tax control, and the elimination of the Oil Deliverance Law. According to PISTON it is possible to extend protest if the government cannot respond to their grievances.
